integration_interfaces: Android SEND and SEND_MULTIPLE share intents
Wi-Fi Direct peer discovery and TCP data channel
Android NSD local service discovery over available Wi-Fi or wired networks
AndroidKeyStore ephemeral P-256 identity and mutually authenticated TLS 1.3
SAF destination tree with hidden staging files, SHA-256 verification, and publication after validation
security_considerations: Only user-selected peers can proceed; both users must compare and confirm a session code. TLS 1.3 mutual authentication protects the data channel. File names are metadata, transfer frames and allocations are bounded, and each file is SHA-256 checked before publication. AndroidKeyStore backing level varies by device and is not claimed hardware-enforced.
outstanding_blockers: Android SDK compilation and host protocol tests have been added to CI but have not yet passed on this change.
No two-device runtime transfer, sustained throughput, 30 GB / 30 second result, USB-Ethernet route, or storage-provider compatibility has been measured.
Interrupted transfer resume and Bluetooth fallback are not implemented.
